13. REMOVE NO.1 TIMING BELT COVER
(a) Remove the A/C compressor without disconnecting hoses.
(b) Remove the nine bolts, nut, A/C idler pulley bracket, compressor bracket and No.1 timing belt cover.

14. REMOVE TIMING BELT

15. REMOVE IDLER PULLEY AND TENSION SPRING

16. REMOVE CRANKSHAFT TIMING PULLEY
Using SST and a socket wrench, remove the crankshaft timing pulley.
SST 09213-60010 (09213-00020, 09213-00030, 09213-00050)

17. REMOVE OIL PUMP DRIVE PULLEY
Using a screwdriver to hold the pulley, remove the pulley bolt and pulley.
